scope: 93 newly authored SRS review cards in the 31 grammar-system gaps; existing 628 grammar review cards require a separate later audit
guidance: Record both natural sentence acceptability and whether the reviewed target grammar was demonstrated. Do not label correct Korean wrong merely because it uses a different construction. Hints should identify the exact tense, register, honorific, aspect or formation difference. Never assert a generic LLM equivalence as fact without contextual validation.
status: editorial first-pass examples for future answer grader and educator review; NOT executable grading logic
defaultWhenNoNearMissListed: No special near-miss rule annotated yet, not a claim that all other answers are impossible.
